_about: Layer 2 of the syscall reference: hand-written notes per syscall, merged into
wiki/docs/assets/syscalls360.json by re/syscall_ref.py and shown on the page.
Keys are the number as "0xNNNN" (4 hex digits). Every field is optional:
name        our name for it (shown in place of the public name, marked as ours)
prototype   a C prototype, e.g. "void PowerOff(int displayLogo)"
description plain text, a few sentences, written by us (never copied from WikiPrizm)
confidence  tested (seen working: a probe, an emulator test), read (read from the
notes       for us only, not published
